fields.description: Whether the person this read was performed FOR was actually a member of this room at the time of the read. This is the field that makes the log worth keeping: a non-empty set of was_participant = 0 rows is precisely the oversight event decision #12 exists to make visible. Computed per room per read, never inferred later - membership changes.
fields.label: Was Participant

fields.description: The seq range actually read, which is what makes an audit record useful. 'They looked at that room once' is not. Both are 0 when the read did not resolve to specific rows.
fields.label: First Seq
